name: Backwards Pluck
author: Oroboro
notes:
ReverseDelay, a compiled module (OroboroModules/ReverseDelay): a plucked string from the keys, into the FX area, where ReverseDelay plays each half second back reversed: the note swells in from its tail and ends on its pluck.

Try:
- Time: short for a backwards flutter, long for whole phrases turned round.
- Feedback: the next echo is reversed again, so forwards; more of it, and the phrases pile up.
- Tone, and Mix (all wet for the backwards part alone).
